questions.question: 1. Assume a = 5, b = 0 and c = -2. Calculate ( a | b ) > c

explanations.a: Incorrect, (a | b) = 5 | 0 = 5, 5 > -2 is true, so 0 is not correct.
explanations.b: Correct. (a | b) = 5 | 0 = 5, 5 > -2 is true, so 1 is correct.
explanations.c: Incorrect, 5 is the value of (a | b), not the result of the comparison.
explanations.d: Incorrect, -2 is the value of c, not the result of the comparison.
